title: 第一章：好大一条蛇啊！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

十五的月亮十六圆，这句话说的一点也没错。昨天刚过中秋节现在正是十六。

现在正是凌晨三点，明亮的月光从天空照射进树林之中，洒在一动也不动苏行枫身上的枯草上，苏行枫用枯草遮盖了全身，只露出一双明亮的眼睛正四处张望。

‘这是第三天了，那家伙还不出来？这会不会是打怕了吧？’

苏行枫从部队退伍已经有四个月了，现正在爷爷留下的自留山中居住。苏行枫10岁时，他的父母在一次车祸中去世。为便于照顾他，苏行枫的爷爷将其带回老家抚养。由于爷爷年岁已高，在苏行枫入伍第四年时他爷爷也去世了。

青山便是苏行枫爷爷留给他的唯一财产了，正如山名一样绿水青山鸟语花香，这座山是祖上留下来的。青山由四座山头组成，呈正三角，三座小山包围着中间的那座高山，正如爷爷所说“留得青山在，不怕没柴烧”所以祖上从他爷爷的爷爷那一代开始就开始在山上种树，砍过多少就种回多少，直到现在这山上到处都是大树。

村里一直劝说他爷爷把山上的树砍了当钱卖，可是直到他爷爷去世，他爷爷也不肯，还让苏行枫不能让人把山毁了。

苏行枫现在是青山唯一继承者，也是他唯一一个亲人留下的念想。当村书记再一次找到苏行枫时，苏行枫和他爷爷一样“这是我爷爷留给我的，我就要守住它”。

从小就听爷爷说山上有一只黄皮子，那黄皮子都快成精了。从他爷爷那个时候就有出现过，所以他们家从来没有养过鸡鸭之类的家禽，因为你养多少都会被那黄皮子偷吃掉。

苏行枫因为刚退伍，觉得自己一身本事感觉可以对付它。所以他从两个月前就从市场进了四五十只鸡在家里养着，可是每过一两天就少几只，直到半个月前没就全没了。

他从上个星期就开始做好了准备，他要把那黄皮子给灭了。今晚正是第七天，前几天他差一点就把黄皮子给杀了。

“接近了，再往前走一步...”

这个时候一只全身银白色的黄鼠狼从一棵大树后出来，它正要经过苏行枫布置的一个陷阱。

“咔擦...”

“吱..吱...”

此时陷阱机关触发，锋利的竹钉打在那银白色的黄鼠狼左后脚上，把它卡在那，但是很快的在黄鼠狼拼命挣扎中还是挣脱了。

“又失误了，低估了它，早知就换上铁钉好了”

苏行枫看到黄鼠狼挣脱了自己的陷阱，碎了一句后立刻串出草丛，向着黄鼠狼逃跑的方向追去。

黄鼠狼的动作很灵敏，虽说后脚受了重伤，就这样也跑的很快。苏行枫在后面死死的盯住它，最后只见那只黄鼠狼钻进一个树洞中：

“现在看你往哪跑，哈哈，看小爷今天把你烧死”

苏行枫看到那黄鼠狼正好进了一棵自己设置好机关的那棵树树洞中，他很是开心。他从树旁草丛中拿出一张铁丝网，把那树洞堵上，然后拿了一把尺子在树干上量了一下。

“不算太高，就从这里开始”

他这是在算这树洞高度，因为之前有弄好的，现在他打算就利用这树洞把这只黄鼠狼在这烧死它。直到天亮时，苏行枫把这棵树树洞以上的枝叶全砍了，再把周围一些干草什么的全清了一遍，这是为了不引起山火。

他又找来更多的铁丝网把这树桩包的严严实实的，咋看上去像是准备浇筑的水泥柱子。

“现在你死定了，不管你是不是成精了，就算你再怎么叫也没用，哈哈！！”

苏行枫在四处看了一下，发现没有什么纰漏，提了一桶汽油就往树桩上浇。

“轰...”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The moon on the fifteenth day is sixteen round. This saying is absolutely correct.The Mid-Autumn Festival just passed yesterday and it is now the 16th.

It was now three o'clock in the morning, and the bright moonlight shone from the sky into the woods, shining on the withered grass on Su Xingfeng who was motionless. Su Xingfeng covered his whole body with the withered grass, only revealing a pair of bright eyes looking around.

‘This is the third day, and the guy still hasn’t come out?Could this be because of fear?’

It has been four months since Su Xingfeng retired from the army and is now living in the mountain where his grandfather left him.When Su Xingfeng was 10 years old, his parents died in a car accident.In order to take care of him, Su Xingfeng's grandfather took him back to his hometown to raise him.Because his grandfather was old, his grandfather also passed away in Su Xingfeng's fourth year of joining the army.

Qingshan is the only property left to him by Grandpa Su Xingfeng. Just like the name of the mountain, green water, green mountains, birds singing and fragrance of flowers, this mountain is left by his ancestors.Qingshan is composed of four hills, forming a right triangle, with three hills surrounding the high mountain in the middle. As my grandfather said, "If you keep the green hills, you won't have to worry about running out of firewood." So my ancestors started planting trees on the mountains from his grandfather's generation, and planted back as many as they cut down. Until now, there are big trees everywhere on this mountain.

The village had been persuading his grandfather to cut down the trees on the mountain and sell them for money, but until his grandfather passed away, his grandfather refused and told Su Xingfeng not to let others destroy the mountain.

Su Xingfeng is now the only successor of Qingshan, and the only memory left by his relatives.When the village secretary found Su Xingfeng again, Su Xingfeng was like his grandfather, "This is what my grandfather left to me, and I will keep it."

Ever since I was a child, I heard from my grandfather that there was a yellow-skinned man on the mountain, and that yellow-skinned man was about to become a spirit.It had appeared since his grandfather's time, so their family had never raised poultry such as chickens and ducks, because no matter how many you raised, they would be eaten by those yellow-skinned ones.

Because Su Xingfeng had just retired from the army, he felt that he had the skills to deal with it.So he bought forty or fifty chickens from the market two months ago and raised them at home, but every day or two there were fewer chickens, until half a month ago they were all gone.

He had been preparing since last week. He was going to destroy the yellow man.Tonight is the seventh day, and he almost killed Huang Pizi a few days ago.

"We're close, take another step forward..."

At this time, a silver-white weasel came out from behind a big tree and was about to pass through a trap set by Su Xingfeng.

"Kacha..."

"Squeak...squeak..."

At this time, the trap was triggered, and the sharp bamboo nails hit the silver-white weasel's left hind foot and stuck it there. However, the weasel quickly broke free despite its desperate struggle.

"Another mistake. I underestimated it. If I had known better, I would have replaced it with iron nails."

When Su Xingfeng saw the weasel breaking free from his trap, he immediately jumped out of the grass and chased in the direction where the weasel escaped.

The weasel's movements were very agile, and even though its hind legs were seriously injured, it could still run very fast.Su Xingfeng stared at it from behind, and finally saw the weasel getting into a tree hole:

"Now let's see where you run, haha, let's see I burn you to death today."

Su Xingfeng was very happy when he saw the weasel entering the hole of the tree where he had set up the trap.He took out a barbed wire fence from the grass next to the tree, blocked the hole in the tree, and then took a ruler and measured it on the trunk.

“It’s not too high, just start from here.”

He was calculating the height of the tree hole, because he had made it before, and now he planned to use the tree hole to burn the weasel here.Until daybreak, Su Xingfeng cut off all the branches and leaves above the tree hole, and then cleared away all the hay and other things around it, in order not to cause a mountain fire.

He found more barbed wire and wrapped the tree stump tightly. It looked like a cement pillar ready to be poured.

"You are dead now, no matter if you are a sperm or not, it will be useless no matter how much you scream, haha!!"

Su Xingfeng looked around and found nothing wrong, so he took a bucket of gasoline and poured it on the tree stump.

"Boom..."
